verdict.rationale: Anytype documents an official "Anytype MCP Server" on its developer portal. It lets AI assistants interact with Anytype's API through natural language, and a probe confirms the page exists. The server sits on a documented local API covering spaces, objects, types and templates. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent, and detail in the pack on setup steps, transport and the tools the server exposes.
